thread:
elaine: Quick sync — proposal: signal-driven gating for regional rollouts. Want an operator handshake for canaries + automated fallback. TL;DR: metrics = p50 latency, error-rate, and model-quality (eval harness). Rollout slices: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m bake per step; operator ack required for any step >5%. Thoughts?
sam: I like the signal-driven bit. Two quick asks: (1) define exact thresholds (error-rate, latency p50/p95 deltas), (2) make the operator handshake optional (flag) for low-risk experiments.
michael: SRE caution — alert fatigue if we hook on too many signals. Recommend composite alerts: only fire when error-rate > 2x baseline AND p50 increase > 30% for 3m. Also prefer synthetic probes for model-quality smoke checks (not just user traffic).
anya: Operator handshake = human click? Ops perspective: we need a single-button acknowledge in Console + audit log entry. Also want a pre-bake checklist in the runbook: capacity checks, model-variant mapping, fallback ARN.
elaine: Agree on audit log + button. For thresholds propose: error-rate relative + absolute floor (eg >0.5% and >2x baseline), p50 delta >25%, model-quality drop >1% on eval set. If synthetic probe fails we skip to fallback immediately.
sam: Feature-flag surface to implement: rollout_percentage, operator_ack_required, fallback_model, fallback_region, kill_switch. Example API to create rollout: 
```
rb flags create --name model-rollout-<id> \
  --percent=5 \
  --operator-ack=true \
  --fallback=redwood-tiny-v2 \
  --regions=us-west-2,eu-west-1
```
That way infra can auto-enforce.
jessica: Customer asks: per-tenant opt-in plus the ability for sales to request accelerated ramps. That means flag scoping needs tenant-level overrides and an approval workflow for exceptions.
michael: For auto-rollback semantics: if composite alert holds for 5m -> trigger immediate rollback to fallback model and notify oncall + ticket with trace link. Keep a cooldown 30m to prevent thrash.
anya: We need an operator handshake definition doc. Proposal: two modes: manual-ack (explicit human button) and semi-auto (allow auto-advance if synthetic + low risk). Ops will own runbook and the manual button.
elaine: Decision proposal: start with default: manual-ack for >5% step and tenant-scoped flags opt-in. Semi-auto mode behind experimental flag for power users. Bake times: 1%: 15m, 5%: 30m, 25%: 60m. Add canary health checks: synthetic probe, error-rate composite, quality-smoke.
sam: Can implement canary health engine to evaluate composite signals and emit a single boolean health check per slice. Also add a TTL for KV cache invalidation during rollouts (don't poison caches).
jessica: Sales ask noted. We need a short PRD section for tenant overrides + approval SLA (24h).
deploy-bot: canary:start region=eu-west-1 slice=1% id=rollout-1797654321
sam: Nice — test that the canary health engine respects operator_ack flag (should pause before advancing).
michael: Also add chaos window protection — don't advance during known infra incidents and add a hard block if region is degraded (from status page).
anya: Action: I'll draft operator-handshake runbook + Console button spec. ETA EOD tomorrow. owner=anya
sam: Action: I'll prototype health engine and flags API. ETA 2 weeks. owner=sam
jessica: Action: I'll add tenant-override flow to PRD and coordinate with sales. ETA 3 business days. owner=jessica
elaine: Action: I'll write rollout gating thresholds doc + coordinate final sign-off with SRE. ETA 48h. owner=elaine
michael: I'll prepare oncall playbook for automated rollback notifications. ETA 72h. owner=michael
elaine: OK — consensus seems positive. We'll run a small internal canary next week on eu-west-1 with manual ack for the 5% step. Please post any concerns here. :thumbsup:
